title: Vision Solicitation Ingestion API Contract v1
description: REST API for creating and listing solicitations. Federal (SAM.gov) intake is async via the existing jobs queue; state/local intake is synchronous. Document attachment reuses the existing /api/cases/{case_id}/ingest endpoint.

documents.description: Documents attached to the backing case (reuses CaseManager._list_documents).

url.description: Required. SAM.gov opportunity URL (federal) or agency portal URL (state/local).

title.description: Required for state/local (no programmatic metadata source). Optional for federal — a placeholder is used until sam_fetch populates the real title; if provided it is used as the initial case/solicitation name regardless.

CreateSolicitation.notes: For source_type='federal', title falls back to 'Untitled SAM.gov Opportunity (fetching...)' if omitted. For source_type='state'|'local', title is required — 400 if missing.

solicitations_create.summary: Create a solicitation. Federal: creates case+solicitation synchronously, enqueues a sam_fetch job. State/local: fully synchronous, no job.

201.description: Created solicitation (federal includes job_id; state/local does not)

job_id.description: sam_fetch job id for federal; null for state/local.

400.description: Validation error — missing url, or missing title for state/local

solicitations_create.notes: For federal, notice_id is extracted server-side from the URL before insert. If a solicitations row with that notice_id already exists, return 409 with its external_id instead of creating a duplicate case.

solicitations_list.summary: List solicitations, filterable by source_type and ingestion_status

solicitations_get.summary: Get a solicitation with its backing case's documents

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid Bearer token

body.detail: Solicitation already exists for this notice_id

422.description: Validation error — request body failed Pydantic validation

designNotes.reuseOfExistingEndpoints: Document attachment for state/local (and manual remediation for federal) reuses POST /api/cases/{case_id}/ingest unchanged. Job polling for federal fetch reuses GET /api/jobs/{job_id} and GET /api/jobs unchanged. No new document or job endpoints are introduced by this contract.
designNotes.federalFlow: 1) POST /api/solicitations {source_type:'federal', url} -> extract noticeId server-side -> check notice_id uniqueness -> INSERT cases + solicitations (ingestion_status='pending') -> enqueue sam_fetch job -> 201 {solicitation, job_id}. 2) Client polls GET /api/jobs/{job_id}. 3) Worker's sam_fetch handler sets ingestion_status='fetching' then 'complete'/'failed', populates metadata columns, calls ingest_file per resourceLink (documents.source='sam_gov').
designNotes.stateLocalFlow: POST /api/solicitations {source_type:'state'|'local', url, title} -> INSERT cases + solicitations (ingestion_status='complete', no job) -> 201 {solicitation, job_id: null}. Client then calls POST /api/cases/{case_id}/ingest per document as usual.
designNotes.notFederalScope: AI triage/extraction of state/local solicitation content (title/agency/deadline auto-fill) is out of scope — see Brief §7 Out of Scope.
